items.title: Asian benchmarks trade mixed following rally on Wall Street led by technology issues
items.summary: Asian shares were trading mixed Friday, as market sentiment for some regional benchmarks got a boost from the tech-led rally on Wall Street.  Japan's benchmark Nikkei 225 rose 1.3% to finish at 65,020.94.  Hong Kong's Hang Seng jumped 1.8% to 25,658.73, while the Shanghai Composite lost 0.5% to 3,921.40.
